description: This Card is especially for the energy Sector. I can take Categories, Date, and 2 Measures as an Input. It automatically calculates the different of the vales compared to last period. It visualizes the trend and show the actual and the last value. Key features: Instant Insight: The large, bold figure at the top right provides a clear view of the latest value, making it easy to see your progress for last period. Growth Highlights: The 100% increase from the previous month is marked prominently, ensuring you never miss a significant upward trend. Regional Performance Comparison: The lines represent data trends in the Categories, allowing you to quickly assess performance by Category and spot key differences. User-Friendly Design: With clean lines, contrasting colors, and clear labels, this chart ensures that your data is not only accessible but also visually compelling. Perfect for dashboards, reports, or presentations, this chart is a must-have tool for teams focused on performance, trends, and strategic decision-making. Take your data visualization to the next level with a chart that tells a story at a glance!
